usecase.name: [QA Validation App] UJ-1 Delete User Removes Team Membership
usecase.description: Admin creates a team and a user in it, deletes the user, and the user is gone from Users and from the team's members

steps.instruction: Focus the username field
Focus the password field
Click the 'Sign in' button
Open /admin/teams
Click the 'Create Team' button
Type '[QA Test] Team {{UniqueID}}' in the Team name field
Click the 'Create' button in the dialog
Is a team named '[QA Test] Team {{UniqueID}}' listed in the table?
Click the 'Users' item in the left navigation
Click the 'Create User' button
Type 'qa-test-{{UniqueID}}@example.com' in the Email field
Select 'Editor' in the Role dropdown
Select '[QA Test] Team {{UniqueID}}' in the Team dropdown
Click the 'Create User' button in the dialog
Is a user with email 'qa-test-{{UniqueID}}@example.com' listed in the table?
Click the 'Teams' item in the left navigation
Click the team name '[QA Test] Team {{UniqueID}}'
Is 'qa-test-{{UniqueID}}@example.com' listed in the Members table?
Click the 'Users' item in the left navigation
Click the 'Delete' button in the row of user 'qa-test-{{UniqueID}}@example.com'
Click the 'Delete' button in the confirmation dialog
Is a user with email 'qa-test-{{UniqueID}}@example.com' listed in the table?
Click the 'Teams' item in the left navigation
Click the team name '[QA Test] Team {{UniqueID}}'
Is 'qa-test-{{UniqueID}}@example.com' listed in the Members table?
Click the 'Teams' item in the left navigation
Click the 'Delete' button in the row of team '[QA Test] Team {{UniqueID}}'
Click the 'Delete' button in the confirmation dialog
Is a team named '[QA Test] Team {{UniqueID}}' listed in the table?
